Ramblepost, turn hackathon notes into a clean DEV post by voice.

## What I built
I enter a lot of hackathons. This month I did about 10 of them: DEV challenges, Devpost, Graph Hacks. After each build I waste hours turning scattered notes into a proper post. I built Ramblepost to fix that. You just talk about what you built and it gives you a clean DEV post or Devpost story draft in plain language. It also tells you which facts you forgot, like the demo link or the repo link.

## Demo
[demo link]

## How I built it
I used Wispr Flow and talked to Cursor's agent. No typing. The app is a Next.js project with Tailwind and Groq writes the drafts.

## What was hard
The first drafts messed up. They said my app records audio and removes filler words, which I never said. It also used weird dashes, so I told the agent to make the rules way stricter. I spent ages figuring out where the env file goes and I almost went gaming with Caps Lock still set as my Wispr key.

## What I learned
Talking is way faster than typing for the boring parts. You have to be really strict with AI so it doesn't invent stuff.
